_: Texas places and the point each one is measured from. Used to measure how far a listing's city is from the home base (MAX_MILES_FROM_BASE). Every Texas row of GeoNames cities1000 — every populated place of 1,000 or more — as bundled in the reverse_geocoder 1.5.1 package on PyPI (its data file rg_cities1000.csv). GeoNames data is CC BY 4.0: https://www.geonames.org/. A place under 1,000 people is not here; the screener asks the Census geocoder for that parcel instead, and a row neither can place is flagged distance_unknown, never rejected. Rebuild with scripts/tax_deed_places.py rather than by hand.
